name: S-5 Security-grade blaster/ascension gun
description: The S-5 Security-grade blaster/ascension gun, S-5 blaster pistol, simply known as a Naboo blaster, and nicknamed the "climbing pistol," was a model of heavy blaster pistol and ascension gun that was used by some members of the Royal Naboo Security Forces, including Captain Quarsh Panaka. Perosei could disassemble and reassemble a Naboo blaster in sixty seconds.
